methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: This phone should work great for my everyday tasks. With its fast processor, it can handle all my social media and study needs smoothly without lagging. The 120Hz display is also a big plus for smooth scrolling and video watching.
construct_responses.EE: It's pretty easy to use considering I'm already familiar with Android. The clean UI will make it simple to navigate and won't require much time to get used to. Plus, the ad-free experience is a nice touch.
construct_responses.HM: I think I'll enjoy using it for gaming and watching videos. The display quality and battery life are excellent for long sessions. The camera is also good for taking photos and videos, especially during college events.
construct_responses.SI: My friends and family would likely recommend this phone. It's a well-known brand and the price is really good. They might be surprised to hear I'm considering it, but they'd understand since it has all the features I need.
construct_responses.PP: I feel pretty confident about the privacy and security features. The Smart Privacy Shield is a good addition, and the clean UI means no annoying ads or bloatware. It's definitely better than what I'm used to on iPhones.
construct_responses.BI: Given the price, I think it's a good buy. I would definitely consider switching to this phone. It offers all the features I need at a much lower price than what I'm used to, and the performance is top-notch.
construct_responses.OVERALL: Overall, this phone seems like a solid choice for me. It offers great performance and features at a reasonable price, and I think it will serve my needs well.

persona_summaries.response_text: Overall, this phone seems like a solid choice for me. It offers great performance and features at a reasonable price, and I think it will serve my needs well.
